positiveEvidence: Electra tariff help page dated 2026-07-01 publishes Italy prices of 0.69 EUR/kWh via app and 0.79 EUR/kWh via bank card terminal, VAT included, for slow and fast AC/DC charging.
The same first-party page states these prices apply to sessions started through the Electra app, Autocharge, or bank card terminal and separates possible third-party RFID costs.

Electra+ terms dated 2026-05-20 publish network discounts of -0.10 EUR/kWh (Essential) and -0.20 EUR/kWh (Smart) relative to the public app price, but note station/time variability for subscription pricing and partner-network scope for Smart.
negativeEvidence: Electra explicitly states motorway service-area prices differ from the rest of the network and are shown on the terminal screen; therefore the 0.69/0.79 Italy grid is not promoted to motorway stations.
Electra+ subscription prices are not converted into fixed network-wide absolute prices because the first-party page says the price varies by station and charging time.
No RFID/eMSP tariff is promoted as direct CPO pricing.
